NJ-04.label: Absorption thin
NJ-04.text: With Arbor Terrace's 80 units counted, the project needs about 30% of unmet demand in a 7-mile market. Get a NIC MAP pull and a pre-leasing plan before LOI. Florham Park is the one Morris County pad to advance.

NJ-06.label: Hold: absorption
NJ-06.text: Arbor Terrace Florham Park (80 AL/MC, opening late 2027) uses up most of the unmet demand this pad needs. Hold behind Florham Park; do not pursue both.

NY-03.label: Partner role
NY-03.text: VS Construction controls the site and Benchmark is already the named operator (Planning Board, Feb 3 2026). ATCO's role is capital or GC alongside them, not a separate development.

NY-01.label: Fee development (pending Ben)
NY-01.text: Loses about $7.9M for a for-profit owner even with entrance fees; works with a nonprofit sponsor, with ATCO earning about a $6.7M development fee plus the GC contract. Sunrise is the contract vendee.
